/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/aj-rat-tkia-ak-khoab-nana.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
prefix, rest = original.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
_, body = rest.split(b'---\\n', 1)
roman = \"\"\"1
Aj raat takiya ik khaab nana
Ik khaab nana, haey khaab nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana

2
Sar gae ne khaime uriyaaṅ sawaawaaṅ
Chau gird lagiyaaṅ hin khuni bhaawaaṅ
Arshaaṅ de ronde sultaan nana
Sultaan nana, sultaan nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana

3
Akbar ke dil mein neza gara hai
Shabbir hasrat se dekhta hai
Ammaaṅ ka ujra armaan nana
Armaan nana, armaan nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana

4
Ammaaṅ Fiza ne bahoṅ paae vainr e
Ghash kar ke dig pai Masuma bhainr e
Ummat ne kita nuqsaan nana
Nuqsaan nana, nuqsaan nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana

5
Laashe pe roti haiṅ behneṅ maaeṅ
Girye se apne sab ko rulaaeṅ
Khuni hai saara maidaan nana
Maidaan nana, maidaan nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana

6
Vich Karbala de uriyaaṅ ne khaakaaṅ
Aj diṅ de vele hoiyaaṅ ne raataaṅ
Khaime jalaae sar-e-aam nana,
Sar-e-aam nana, sar-e-aam nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana

7
Sughra se waada tum ne kiya tha
Main jald lautunga ye kaha tha
Pura kiya na paimaan nana
Paimaan nana, paimaan nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana

8
Jeide khulle gesu Sughra da vir e
Vich Karbala de hui akhir e
Is gham ne kita halkaan nana
Halkaan nana, halkaan nana
Akbar bhira nuṅ lagi saangh nana\"\"\"
roman_blocks = roman.split('\\n\\n')
source_blocks = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert [len(block.splitlines()) for block in roman_blocks] == [len(block.splitlines()) for block in source_blocks]
assert all(int(r.splitlines()[0]) == int(s.splitlines()[0]) for r, s in zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks))
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in roman)
indented = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman.splitlines())
p.write_bytes(prefix + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + indented.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
updated = p.read_bytes()
assert updated.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[0] == prefix
assert updated.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].split(b'---\\n', 1)[1] == body
print(f'{len(roman_blocks)} stanzas, {sum(len(block.splitlines()) - 1 for block in roman_blocks)} aligned verses')
PY"

item.text: Audited the Roman transliteration against the source, added the three missing stanzas, and corrected wording and spelling to align all 38 verses across eight stanzas. The original-script text and other metadata were preserved. Dialect-sensitive pronunciations still need human editorial sign-off.
